job.job_description:
We have an immediate opening for the position of AI Engineer on a contract basis. We are looking for strong candidates with hands-on experience in both Generative AI and Classical Machine Learning.
Please find the requirement details below:
Position: AI Engineer
Employment Type: Contract
Contract Duration: 3 Months (Extendable based on project requirement and performance)
Experience Required: 2+ Years
Work Location: Remote
Notice Period: Immediate
Mandatory Skills:
Strong experience in Generative AI concepts and implementations
Hands-on experience with LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning, Embeddings, Vector Databases
Solid experience in Classical Machine Learning algorithms such as Regression, Classification, Clustering, Forecasting, Recommendation Systems, NLP, etc.
Strong coding skills in Python
Experience with frameworks/tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI APIs
Experience in model training, evaluation, deployment, and optimization
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS / Azure / GCP is an added advantage
Good understanding of data structures, APIs, and backend integration
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
Rate Card: 80K/Month
If you have suitable candidates matching the above requirement, please share their updated profiles along with the following details:
Total Experience
Relevant Experience in GenAI
Relevant Experience in Classical ML
Current CTC / Expected Rate
Current Location


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
